stories.title: Pope Leo XIV begins 12-day Latin America tour weeks after lung cancer surgery
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV kicked off a three-nation Latin America tour in Uruguay, three weeks after lung cancer surgery that had put the trip in question. The 12-day journey includes a much-anticipated homecoming to Peru, where he served as a priest.

stories.title: Trump meets Putin's envoy, says Ukraine peace deal near
stories.summary: President Trump confirmed meeting Russian envoy Kirill Dmitriev at the White House but not the visiting Ukrainian delegation, claiming a settlement to the war was close. Trump said any agreement would be 'big' and involve more than Ukraine.

stories.title: Apple's M6 MacBook Pro, OLED iPad mini and M6 iMac go on sale
stories.summary: Apple's new M6 MacBook Pro, OLED iPad mini and M6 iMac are available to buy today, alongside the first touchscreen MacBook Pro. The OLED iPad mini starts at $699 and the M6 iMac at $1,499.

stories.title: M6 MacBook Pro reviews: a solid, iterative upgrade
stories.summary: Early reviews of the 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro call it fast and reliable but a straightforward chip bump in a familiar chassis, with a higher $1,999 starting price. Reviewers say the redesigned OLED touchscreen model is the bigger step forward.

stories.title: Shedeur Sanders gets bad news ahead of first Saints start
stories.summary: With Deshaun Watson in the concussion protocol, the Browns added a key playmaker to the injury report as Shedeur Sanders prepares for his first NFL start. Cleveland visits New Orleans on Sunday.

stories.title: Shedeur Sanders prepares to start as Browns visit Saints
stories.summary: With Deshaun Watson in concussion protocol, Shedeur Sanders is preparing to step in as Cleveland's starter as the Saints seek their first home win of the season.

stories.title: 3 keys to an Ohio State win over Oregon
stories.summary: Ahead of Saturday's top-25 matchup with Oregon, the Buckeyes need a fast start to keep freshman quarterback Luke Fahey in favorable spots and protect their College Football Playoff hopes. Ohio State scored first in each of its October top-25 wins.

stories.title: Ohio State men's basketball preview: expanded NCAA field opens a door
stories.summary: Ohio State men's basketball opens its season Monday night after a stretch of disappointing seasons, and the expanded NCAA Tournament bracket gives the Buckeyes fewer excuses this time.

stories.title: Stroll out sick as Ferrari braces for crunch meeting in Brazil
stories.summary: Aston Martin confirmed Lance Stroll missed Brazilian GP media day recovering from a virus, while Ferrari drivers head into a crunch meeting after the Hamilton-Leclerc Mexico clash. Hamilton says he will 'never be silenced' over the incident.

stories.title: Racing Bulls extend Alan Permane's contract as team principal
stories.summary: Red Bull signed Alan Permane to a long-term deal through 2031 to lead Racing Bulls as team principal and co-CEO. The Faenza-based squad has grown its points under his leadership.

stories.title: Russell to take five-place grid penalty at Brazilian GP
stories.summary: George Russell will take a five-place grid penalty for this weekend's Brazilian Grand Prix after a new engine, his second grid drop in four races. Mercedes chose Brazil for the change with the constructors' title all but sealed.

stories.title: F1 revenue stabilises in Q3 after cancelled 2026 grands prix
stories.summary: Formula 1's revenue held steady over the third quarter of 2026, with Liberty Media reporting roughly $1.1 billion from F1. Team prize payments rose despite the season running two fewer races than 2025.

stories.title: Columbus nonprofit garden hit by crime
stories.summary: The Highland Youth Garden in the Hilltop, which teaches kids gardening and donates its produce, has been dealing with a growing amount of crime. Columbus City Councilmember Melissa Green pledged support for the nonprofit.

stories.title: NBC4 Season of Giving launches holiday wish list for seniors
stories.summary: NBC4's Season of Giving with Besa launched its WISH program, letting people fill a holiday wish list for a central Ohio senior in need. The program has grown from 26 seniors in 2012 to more than 2,000 across 13 counties.

stories.title: Greater Columbus Arts Council announces grants for local artists
stories.summary: The Greater Columbus Arts Council announced thousands of dollars in grants for local artists, supporting creative work across central Ohio.

stories.title: Second round of Ohio high school football playoffs set
stories.summary: The Ohio High School Athletic Association confirmed the regional quarterfinal matchups for the state's high school football playoffs. Games kick off Friday at 7 p.m. across the state.
